name: National Fish Passage Program
summary: US federal funding and technical help for partners that remove dams and other river barriers, replace culverts, restore floodplains or install fishways. Projects are developed with the local Fish and Wildlife Service fish passage biologist before applying.
reporting: Recipients file federal financial reports and programme performance reports, on the schedule set in the notice of award.

applicant_types.quote: The program seeks and develops projects collaboratively with partners, including but not limited to: State and local agencies, Tribes, non-governmental organizations, other Federal agencies

geography.quote: The program is delivered through U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (Service) field offices nationwide.
